Presensi mobile lintas platform dengan v: Cross-platform mobile attendance with GPS location validation, selfie photo verification, and resilience to unstable networks through a local queue buffer.
Dibangun dengan Ionic + Capacitor di ata: Built with Ionic + Capacitor on top of Vue and talking to the government attendance ecosystem's REST API — designed to stay usable in poor-signal areas and on mid-range devices.
Validasi lokasi GPS & radius terhadap ti: GPS location & radius validation against attendance points
Verifikasi foto selfie saat melakukan pr: Selfie photo verification when checking in
Buffer antrean lokal saat koneksi hilang: Local queue buffer when the connection drops
Sinkronisasi otomatis saat koneksi pulih: Automatic sync once the connection returns
Request idempotent — mencegah presensi g: Idempotent requests — preventing duplicate attendance on retry
Presensi sering gagal atau terkirim gand: Attendance often fails or gets sent twice when users are in poor-signal areas — a fatal experience for daily attendance.
Data presensi disimpan sementara di pera: Attendance data is stored temporarily on the device and synced to the server once the connection returns, so attendance is still recorded even if the network drops.
Mekanisme retry idempotent menjamin satu: An idempotent retry mechanism guarantees each attendance is recorded exactly once — with no data duplication on the server side.
